**Latest finding:**

- The Morlet pad was one e-folding short, and the record wrapped onto itself — morlet_power padded by one e-folding time, leaving a ~56-frame zero gap against a 0.5 Hz wavelet needing over twice that, so a burst against one end of the record wrapped circularly onto the other at 2.4% of full band-power scale; three e-foldings drops it to 3e-7. Separately, a truncated record's trailing values are only final two e-foldings back from the cut, not one.
